about: SHA-256 of case-folded, whitespace-joined text (records.text_key). 'benchmark': every message of the 1,022 frozen benchmark cases (254 dev, 512 confirmation, 256 reserve) used to exclude SFT conversations with an identical User message. 'open_panel': User prompts of the 80-prompt open-generation panel, excluded from the long continuation. Hashes only; no benchmark text.
